answer_1.quote: Advancements in data-to-text natural language generation (NLG) have evolved from seq2seq models and vanilla encoder-decoder models towards pretrained language models (PLMs).
answer_1.outputs: natural language text from structured data (RDF triples)

answer_2.quote: For the remaining pipeline stages-lexicalization and surface realization-as well as the outputs of the end-to-end experiment, evaluation was conducted using Meteor and Bleu. Additionally, we included the Comet neural metric, known for its strong correlation with human judgments.

answer_3.quote: Semantic errors such as omissions, additions, and incorrect numbers and entities were identified using GPT-4o 2 on 120 samples each.

answer_4.quote: Two of our authors served as human evaluators for four top models... The evaluators were not informed about which models generated the samples to ensure an impartial assessment.
answer_4.guideline: For proper comparison, they rated fluency and semantic adequacy on a 1-7 Likert scale just as in .
